title: Semantic and World-Space Introduction Targeting
description: Extend the introduction-demonstration IntroductionPoint contract with four new addressing modes: `canvas` (2D world coordinates on infinite-canvas surfaces, the 2D sibling of the existing 3D `scene` variant), `entity` (semantic targeting of a live entity by domain+id using the repo's established pick-target grammar — vortex, object, attraction, node, edge, handle, position, route, block, layer — with "*" meaning any representative), `curve` (arc-length parametric point along an entity's curve geometry), and `domain` (a value mapped through an entity's min/max value domain, e.g. a graph slider). Replace the single-purpose 3D scene-projector registry in ui-react with a general per-window IntroductionSurfaceResolver registry (scenePoint/canvasPoint/entity), resolved every animation frame so demo targets track moving cameras and panning canvases. Wire resolvers into World3d (vortices/objects/attractions), the node graph (adding a Rust entity_screen_json to the dag engine mirroring the tiled map's existing featureScreenJson, since port/handle geometry currently only exists Rust-side), the tiled map (already has an id->screen API), ink canvas, board2d (adding the missing world->screen inverse), and canvas2d/paint2d. Concrete driver: the Aggregator suggest-objects tour step currently right-clicks at window center as a placeholder; it must become a two-gesture demo (left-click then right-click) targeting a real vortex entity.
